name: Make Love Not Waagh!
source:
After an awkward one night stand. You begin a romance with Zanna Frosthammer, an orc girl. As it turns out, she works in the same building you do, as a federal government agent.

However, human/orc relationships can be challenging, for a few reasons. Can love overcome racial boundaries? 

[From [url=https://la-cucaracha-studios.itch.io/make-love-not-waagh]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过一夜尴尬的相处。你与兽人女孩扎娜·霜锤开始了一段浪漫史。事实证明，她是一名联邦政府特工，与你在同一栋大楼里工作。

然而，由于一些原因，人类/兽人的关系可能具有挑战性。爱情可以跨越种族界限吗？

[来自[url=https://la-cucaracha-studios.itch.io/make-love-not-waagh]itch.io[/url]]
